employee.intro.introtext.content:
# Welcome

This form collects the employee details required for the Czech unified employer report from 2026 onwards.

## How to work with the form

Make sure you go through all pages of the form (page switching is at the top).

Where required, attach the supporting documents as well (e.g. a copy of your highest education certificate).

You can save your work in progress at any time with the ```Save draft``` button at the bottom left of the screen. **A draft file is not meant to be handed over to your employer — it is only a backup for you, in case you need to interrupt filling in the form.**

You can load a draft saved this way back into the form at any time and carry on.

Once you believe the form is complete and ready to be handed over, use the ```Check data before submission``` button.

*Note: required fields are marked with an asterisk at the end of their label. If you leave one empty, it is highlighted in red during the check. All required fields must be filled in, otherwise the form cannot be saved for submission.*

If the data passes the basic validation — which still does not guarantee that the social security system will accept it as is — you can save the form with the ```Save questionnaire for submission``` button and e-mail the resulting file to your manager, who will pass all questionnaires on to the payroll office together.

## Important notice

**By sending the completed form to your manager you confirm that you understand the binding nature of this document and accept all consequences of providing incomplete or untrue information. You also acknowledge that you are obliged to report any change of these details to your employer in writing without undue delay.**
